children: Tesla is heading into its third-quarter delivery update with UBS expecting vehicle sales to remain below last year's level, while its estimate still sits above the current consensus.

UBS projects Tesla (TSLA) will deliver roughly 470,000 vehicles for the quarter. That would mark a 5% year-over-year decline and a 1% drop from the second quarter, but the estimate is about 4% higher than Visible Alpha's 454,000 forecast.

The brokerage said market expectations have moved toward a 460,000-to-480,000 range in recent weeks. UBS has not yet received company-collected consensus figures, which are expected before Tesla reports its results.

Beyond vehicle sales, UBS sees energy-storage deployments reaching 16.9 gigawatt-hours. That would be 35% above the year-earlier period and 25% higher sequentially, although the firm said quarterly storage figures can be difficult to assess ahead of the report.
Tesla is scheduled to publish its third-quarter delivery figures on Oct. 2. UBS maintained its Neutral rating and $385 price target, leaving the target close to the stock's recent trading level.

title: UBS Has a Stark Message for Tesla Stock Ahead of Oct. 2
